---
title: "link-external: revealjs"
# bd-t3n1nghb: the transform runs for every HTML-family format, decks
# included, and the deck theme bundles the link-external layer.
format:
  revealjs:
    link-external-icon: true
    link-external-newwindow: true
_quarto:
  tests:
    revealjs:
      noErrorsOrWarnings: true
      ensureHtmlElements:
        - ['section a.external[href="https://example.com/"][target="_blank"][rel="noopener"]']
        - ['a.external[href="about.html"]']
---
